description: Cluster attribute paths read by both the Collector (SwitchbackAttributePath) and analysis (ClickHouseSwitchbackExpr). An unquoted segment is an array index exactly when Guava Ints.tryParse parses it (no '+', ASCII digits only). supported: accepted by isSupported and by requireSupportedAttributePath; a negative index is unsupported because ClickHouse throws ZERO_ARRAY_OR_TUPLE_INDEX on the [0] subscript pathToArgs renders for it. value: what the path resolves to in attributes; null means missing (no cluster key).
